verdict.rationale: Oneleet ships a public API and an MCP server, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence documents no sandbox, test tenant, or dry-run mode. The Scalar reference notes that executing requests needs a real service key against the caller's own workspace data. Scoped service keys and RBAC limit what an agent can do, but they are adjacent access controls, not an isolated environment that keeps tests away from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
